vehicle.notes: UK RHD. Toyota LH/RH = vehicle's own left/right (LH = UK nearside/passenger side, RH = UK offside/driver side). UK hatchback and Touring Sports are built at Burnaston and the saloon in Turkey; numbers can differ from US Corollas, and US-listed numbers seen in searches were excluded. Facelift from the 2023 model year (Aug 2022). Numbers were read from web-search results (titles/summaries) of the cited UK eBay pages; page fetches were blocked and the shared web-search budget ran out early, so only headlamps and front bumpers are covered. Verify by VIN.

parts.notes: eBay UK product page titled 'TOYOTA COROLLA HEADLAMP RIGHT SIDE 8111002T00 MK12 E210 2018-2026' (shown as 8111002T00). Search summaries also described other UK-seller listings giving 81110-02T00 for a RH full-LED unit (one titled 'New Genuine Toyota Corolla 2019-> RHD Right Headlamp Headlight Full Led Type A'), but their URLs could not be pinned down, so they are not counted as a second source. More than one LED headlamp type exists: sellers also list 81110-02T10 (described by some as adaptive LED; not included, no listing URL pinned). Facelift (2023-) fit not checked. Choose by VIN.

eBay UK listing titled 'TOYOTA COROLLA 2019 2020 2021 2022 GENUINE PASSENGER SIDE HEADLIGHT 8115002T00' (shown as 8115002T00). Another UK eBay listing (https://www.ebay.co.uk/itm/257449976732, 'Toyota Corolla 2018 ... 2026 LED Headlight Left') appeared in results for this number, but its page text was not seen, so it is not counted. Pairs with RH 81110-02T00. More than one LED type exists (see 81150-02T10). Choose by VIN.
